description: The marketplace's MCP sidecar toolkit: runs an existing open-source app exactly as its authors release it (downloaded from its own pinned, hash-checked release) and puts the A2App adapter in front of it. Every agent operation is one of the app's own MCP tools; the person's browser gets the app's own UI, passed through untouched. NOT part of the framework.

gate.name: sidecar syntax
gate.run: node --check sidecar/pipeline.mjs && node --check sidecar/serve.mjs && node --check sidecar/mcp.mjs && node --check sidecar/context.mjs && node --check sidecar/upstream.mjs && node --check sidecar/guard.mjs && node --check sidecar/check.mjs && node --check a2app/app.mjs

gate.name: operations resolve (every declared operation maps to an upstream MCP tool or a sidecar operation)
